name: Schwarze's Analytic Inversion
aliases: Accurate Ray-Isosurface Intersection via Cubic Polynomial
definition: An accurate intersection algorithm for iso-surface rendering that analytically computes the intersection of a ray with a trilinearly interpolated implicit surface by solving a cubic polynomial using Cardano's formula.
summary: Schwarze's Analytic Inversion computes exact ray-trilinear iso-surface intersections via cubic polynomials, offering mathematical precision but suffering from high computational cost and numerical instability.
